explanation: It is always 10 at D1 (only about 5 on the episode first trial) and almost always 0 at D2 (rarely 1 to 4 after a run of unrewarded trials). At GO it sits in between, set mainly by the previous reward and the choice: 5 to 7 when the previous trial was rewarded and the agent picks a1 (highest after several rewarded a1 trials in a row), 2 to 4 for a rewarded a2 choice or a switch, and 0 to 2 when the previous trial was unrewarded or the agent has been on a long a2 streak.
